summary: BioHarvest Sciences Inc. filed a Form 6-K for May 2026, attaching a news release dated May 12, 2026, announcing the appointment of Nedira Salzman-Frenkel as Vice President of Business Development for its CDMO division. No financial terms, stake sales, or structural changes are disclosed. This is a routine personnel appointment filing, not a special situation. The Form 6-K serves as a foreign private issuer report under the Exchange Act. There are no deal terms. The announcement is operational in nature, with no impact on capital structure or control.
